currency_note: USD from US retailer listing context; original numerical prices preserved without conversion. The source CSV has no currency column.
capture_date: Not provided per observation. Repository dataset release is not a price capture date.
image_transform: Original dataset image URLs downloaded; converted to RGB JPEG, maximum edge 640px, quality 88. Original URLs and cached image SHA retained.
curation: Reviewed subset, not automatic acceptance of match=1. Each accepted pair was checked against both listings for model, colour, size, pack and condition; false matches found in the same source are listed in CURATION_REPORT.json. Sears rows that contradict their own model fields were not included. No simulated prices. Source review is not independent retailer verification.
